scope: Prepared metadata only. Apply once A-30 supports optional registered 3D-only entries without a 2D scene or unused dataKey. The browser descriptors have test-only content keys; those are deliberately omitted here. No runtime registry edit is made.

entries.title: Drive safely through a school zone.
entries.blurb: Keep to the school-zone speed limit, stop for the flashing school bus and wait for children to clear the crossing.
learn: Wait for the school bus and children.
entries.controls: Use the physical cab controls or their keyboard shortcuts. Follow the sat nav and press the finish key after parking.

entries.title: Drive safely through three junctions.
entries.blurb: Drive through the stop-sign, red-light and give-way approaches, then park in each marked bay.
learn: Read the junction controls and give way safely.
entries.controls: Use the physical cab controls or their keyboard shortcuts.

entries.title: Drive safely at night.
entries.blurb: Inspect the headlights, follow the night route with a safe gap and park in the marked bay.
learn: Check the headlights and maintain a safe following gap.
entries.controls: Use the physical inspection and cab controls or their keyboard shortcuts.
